art_direction.summary: Documentary lifestyle of Marie Durand-class ops: FR CEE back-office mornings, compliance huddles, quiet focus — not lifestyle consumer ads.

subject_direction.demographics: French operations / compliance professionals, approx. 28–50, mid-market energy services or délégataire orgs (50–500 employees)
subject_direction.style: Business-casual FR office: muted neutrals, no loud logos; natural hair/makeup; glasses ok
subject_direction.expression: Focused, calm, competent — never exaggerated smile or stock celebration
subject_direction.diversity_notes: Reflect contemporary French workplace diversity; avoid token staging
subject_direction.avoid: Hard hats as primary motif, construction-site clichés, consumer renovation influencers

scenarios.name: Morning dossier triage
scenarios.activity: Sorting CEE dossier folders before validation
scenarios.key_message: Pre-submission care reduces avoidable document risk

scenarios.name: Compliance huddle
scenarios.activity: Ops manager and compliance officer review exception queue

scenarios.name: Training new operator
scenarios.activity: Senior operator onboarding junior on programme rules
scenarios.key_message: Programme rules change; tools should shorten ramp

scenarios.name: Obligé / délégataire call
scenarios.activity: Clarifying roles on a dossier handoff
